verdict.rationale: LibreChat documents the bring-your-own-backend half of the story. Self-hosters configure their own providers and API keys through librechat.yaml custom endpoints, including OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic-compatible, OpenRouter and Ollama, and community users describe running it on their own API access. Nothing in the pack shows token-usage or cost visibility per model or per conversation. missing for 10: token usage tracking, cost reporting per model or per conversation, BYO subscription (vs API key) support, independent corroboration of usage/cost features
